expl: A great circle is that line which divides a sphere into two hemispheres. Upon the Earth, all the meridians longitudes and the Equator are great circles. Except for the equator no other latitude is a great circle because they are smaller in comparison to the Equator.

stem: A plane starts flying from 300 northern latitude and 500 eastern longitude and lands at the opposite end of the earth, where will it land –
expl: At the opposite end of the earth, the plane will land at 30o southern latitude and 130o western longitude.

stem: Among the following cities which one lies in the farthest North ?
expl: On the globe, the northernmost and southernmost positions of a place, city and country are decided by latitudes. The greater the angle of the latitude of a place in the southern or northern hemisphere the more southernmost or northernmost point, Position of the following cities are – (City) (Latitude) Beijing (China) 390 55' N New Delhi (India) 280 38' N New York (U.S.A.) 400 45' N Rome (Italy) 410 54' N The Latitude of Rome is highest in comparison to the other cities. stem: How many latitudes are there on the globe drawn at 1 degree interval?
expl: If parallels of latitude are drawn at an interval of one degree, there will be 89 parallels in the northern and the southern hemisphere each. The total number of parallels thus drawn, including the equator, will be 179.
